question: What effect does daily fasting have on age-related death?
premises: Age-related death will be undergone or overcome.
inference: Through daily fasting, one will go beyond age-related death.
uncertainties: The exact sense of gamiṣyate with mṛtyuṃ is ambiguous; it may mean approaching or transcending death.
plain_english: By fasting for a day, one will overcome death from old age.
